answer: In the decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, we employ a novel Sybil resistance mechanism, wherein autonomous agents are incentivized to maintain a quill of reputation by staking a significant amount of native tokens, which are then locked in a basalt-hardened smart contract.
